entities.summary: Jarell Alexander Eddie is an American professional basketball player who last played for Al-Ittihad Jeddah of the Saudi Premier League. He played college basketball for Virginia Tech before splitting the first four years of his professional career in the NBA and NBA G League. Since 2018, Eddie has played in Europe.
